The '''Parshoone Sector Service Academy''' was a training center for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] soldiers located in the [[Perinn sector/Legends|Perinn sector]]. [[Isila Drutch]] trained there for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
